jobs.description: Work as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online in Barendrecht. Earn €18.83 gross per hour all-in from age 21, with part-time and full-time options. Wat bieden wij? An all-in gross hourly wage of €18.83 from age 21. Travel allowance. Pension scheme. Holiday allowance and vacation days. The choice of weekly or four-weekly salary payments. Part-time and full-time opportunities. Morning shifts from 06:00 AM to 02:00 PM. Afternoon/evening shifts from 03:00 PM to 11:00 PM. Practical training when you start. The opportunity to join an experienced colleague during your first working days. Opportunities to develop within Albert Heijn Online and Consolid. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Barendrecht As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online, you make sure customers receive their online grocery orders at home. Your shift starts in Barendrecht, where you prepare for the route ahead. Once everything is ready, you get behind the wheel and drive to the first customer on your schedule. At each address, you take the correct grocery order from the van and carry the crates to the customer's front door. You hand over the groceries carefully, provide friendly service and collect empty crates when necessary. Once the delivery is complete, you continue to the next stop. Driving is only one part of your working day. You regularly get in and out of the van, walk between the vehicle and customers' homes and lift grocery crates. This makes the role a combination of driving, physical activity and customer contact. After completing your final delivery, you return to the location in Barendrecht and finish your shift. Frequently asked questions Do I need previous delivery experience? No. Previous experience as a delivery driver or courier is not required. You will receive training before working independently. During your first working days, you can join an experienced colleague and learn how a normal delivery route works in practice. What are the working hours?There are two main shifts: Morning shift: 06:00 AM – 02:00 PM Afternoon/evening shift: 03:00 PM – 11:00 PM Both part-time and full-time opportunities are available. Is Saturday availability required? Yes. You must be available for at least two Saturdays per month. This is a mandatory requirement for the position. Is this a physically active job? Yes. You will regularly carry grocery crates and walk between the delivery van and customers' doors. You therefore need to be physically able to perform these tasks throughout your shift. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Barendrecht You have a valid category B driving licence. You are physically able to lift and carry grocery crates. You are friendly and customer-focused. You are comfortable working independently. You have a sufficient command of Dutch and/or English. You are available for the agreed shifts. You can work at least two Saturdays per month. Previous delivery experience is not required. Interested in working as a delivery driver in Barendrecht? Apply through Consolid for Albert Heijn Online. For questions about the position, contact Seyyed Helal Parwiz by phone or WhatsApp at 06 83110102, or email s.parwiz@consolid.nl.
